messages:
Nora: Heads-up: sudden spike in tiny GPU pod evictions in ap-southeast1c over the past 18m. Cost blip +18%. Anyone oncall? :eyes:
infra-bot: ALERT: evictions_gpu.ap-southeast1c = 5.8/min (10m avg).
Jae: Do we have recent node label/taint changes?
Nora: We rolled gpu.family label enforcement yesterday to move traffic to rtxA. Node sample: Labels: gpu.family=rtxA, nodepool=prod-tight; Taints: nvidia.com/gpu=present:NoSchedule. Old rtx7 nodes still exist in the pool.
Omar: That matches earlier pattern: lots of small pods request gpu.family=rtx7 via required nodeAffinity -> scheduler rejects rtxA nodes despite available GPU capacity -> overpack on rtx7 nodes -> eviction when medium jobs land.
Priya: Scheduler log capture: ```E0412 11:43:12.721 predicate.go:104] Pod ml/tiny-encoder-412 failed Fit: node(s) didn't match node affinity: node(s) had no matching labels```
Vik: Quick mitigation options: 1) bump AZ warm-pool, 2) mutate strict affinities to preferred for pods requesting <=1 GPU, 3) temporarily flip NoSchedule taint -> PreferNoSchedule on subset of rtxA nodes.
Jae: Can we run a quick audit for pods with required gpu.family affinity? Nora, can you paste a jq one-liner?
Nora: Sure: ```kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.affinity.nodeAffinity != null) | select(.spec.affinity.nodeAffinity.requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution != null) | select(.spec.affinity.nodeAffinity.requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution.nodeSelectorTerms[]?.matchExpressions[]? | select(.key=="gpu.family")) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name) -> required gpu.family"' | wc -l
> 127```
infra-bot: RUNBOOK: warmpool_scale triggered by Nora at 2025-04-12T11:46:01Z. warmpool.prod-tight.ap-southeast1c 5 -> 13 (run id rp-4892).
Omar: I'm going to flip taint effect on three rtxA nodes as a hotfix to allow scheduling pressure to spread. Doing nodes gpu-node-54, gpu-node-55, gpu-node-56.
Priya: I'll draft a mutating webhook to rewrite required->preferred for pods matching label ml-tier=tiny and requests.nvidia.com/gpu <= "1". Canary to ml namespace first. Patch will include weight 100 preference for gpu.family values.
Jae: Also increase the binpack scheduler's imbalance_tolerance to 0.18 for this AZ to let mixed-family packing happen while we remediate. Monitor NVLink/thermal metrics closely though.
Nora: Taint changes applied and warmpool scaled. Metrics: evictions.ap-southeast1c 5.8 -> 1.3 over 9m. unschedulable_count 58 -> 10. infra-bot notes cost drift reduced.
Vik: Good. Longer-term: TICKET-4892 - "ap-southeast1c tiny-pod eviction due to gpu.family enforcement". Action items: inventory remaining rtx7-bound workloads, add CI gate preventing required gpu.family on new images, and evaluate a packing-aware scheduler plugin that respects fractional GPU/co-location constraints.
Omar: I'll add an operator that flags PRs which add required gpu.family in pod spec. Also propose a migration plan for rtx7 legacy jobs within 30 days.
Priya: Canary webhook rolled to 15% in ml namespace; initial results: ~65% of previously unschedulable tiny pods now schedule onto rtxA nodes. No regressions observed in 12m.
Jae: If webhook + warmpool + taint flip doesn't hold within 30m, fallback is to pause label enforcement rollout and cordon the prod-tight nodepool for controlled migration.
Nora: Thanks all. Monitoring dashboard pinned to #eng-platform. Will update TICKET-4892 with lists of impacted deployments and owners. :thumbsup:
